if [ ! -e "$state/primary.failed" ]; then echo 'refusing promotion: primary.failed is missing' >&2; exit 1; fi
if ss -ltnH | awk '$4 ~ /(^|:)8081$/ { found=1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }'; then
  echo 'refusing promotion: old primary is still listening on 8081' >&2
  exit 1
fi
